name: Adriana; Occupying the outermost orbit in a diagram of the Tatoo system
description: Adriana was a gas giant located within the Tatoo system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was orbited by several rings consisting of ice. That ice was often mined and transported to the nearby desert world Tatooine, for which it was the most important source of water. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Human Garouf Lafoe was importing ice from Adriana's rings and selling it to Tatooine's inhabitants.
